Name: Turkish Cuisine
Author: Lexith98
Description:
[color=#cc0000][size=6]Features[/size][/color]

[list]
[*][size=3]38 Turkish recipes[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]4 new artisan goods[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]2 new cooking ingredients which can be purchased from Pierre's[/size][/*]
[/list]
That's all. You can find more information (ingredients, gift tastes, mails etc.) in spoiler below.

[spoiler][color=#cc0000][size=5]Recipes[/size][/color]

The numbers next to the names represent how many items you get after [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Cooking]cooking[/url] once. Any milk and egg can be used for the recipes. And note that all cooking items are [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Friendship#Universal_Likes]universal like[/url] by default so the table only shows the exceptions.

[img]https://imgur.com/n0Fu5xv.png[/img]

[color=#cc0000][size=5]Artisan Goods[/size][/color]

These artisan goods can be made with a [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Keg]keg[/url].

[img]https://imgur.com/m9SFADQ.png[/img]

[color=#cc0000][size=5]Mails[/size][/color]

The player's [b]Mom or Dad[/b] sends [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Letters]letters[/url] in the mail the day after [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/The_Player]the player[/url] learns certain amounts of total [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Cooking#Recipes]cooking recipes[/url] earned. If the player is male, he receives letters from Mom. If the player is female, she receives letters from Dad.

[img]https://imgur.com/7tKMaPg.png[/img][/spoiler]

[color=#cc0000][size=6]Installation[/size][/color]

[size=3]Standard installation process. Download the mod with all its requirements (Content Patcher and SMAPI) and extract them to Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/size]
